name: print-social-candle-o-clock-scent-clock-of-ingredient-cutouts
title: Cutout foods arranged as clock numerals around a candle-hands clock over pastel blue
whatItIs: A dusty blue post where photo cutouts (peony, matcha, coconut, croissant, popcorn, vanilla and cinnamon, watermelon, melon, banana bread) are placed around a clock face with long silver hands over big pink italic serif 'CANDLE O'CLOCK'. A pink sparkle and yellow serif 'SCENT' sit at the corners and yellow caps text at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Sweet and witty; a clock of scents says 'a fragrance for every moment'.
techniques: Arrange cutouts as clock numerals with real clock hands.
Use pink italic serif over the clock centre.
Set bottom copy in yellow caps.

vocabulary.definition: Items arranged around a clock face.
Images of ingredients evoking a fragrance.
Elegant italic text over a graphic.
A four-point star used as decoration.
